# Guardian Overseer Report — 2026-05-10T07:04Z

## Overall Status: ⚠️ DEGRADED (1 Critical Issue)

5 guardian jobs monitored | 113 runs in 24h | 93.2% avg success rate | 0 skips | 0 disabled

## Critical: Telegram Inbound Polling Down

Detected by Guardian Pulse at 07:01 UTC. Onset ~02:23 UTC (4.5h before this report). Agent cannot receive Telegram messages.

Server logs at 07:00-07:04 show outbound sends partially working (fetch errors, falling back edit→new) but inbound polling is stopped.

**Escalation gap**: Guardian Pulse classified this CRITICAL but did NOT raise an attention queue item. The GP→attention pipeline is broken.

## Timeout Pattern (3 in 24h)

- health-check at 06:45 UTC: 77s (killed)
- degradation-digest at May 9 23:00: 147s (killed)
- session-continuity-check at May 9 19:03: 144s (killed)

All isolated. Two of the three (degradation-digest and session-continuity-check) hit their timeouts in the 19:00-23:00 UTC window — possible load pattern.

## Coverage Gaps

1. No handoff notes from any guardian job — each run starts blind with no prior context
2. Guardian Pulse → attention queue escalation not firing for CRITICAL findings
3. 6-8h check intervals mean a Telegram failure can go undetected for hours (confirmed: this one went 4.5h before guardian-pulse caught it)
